Samaritan is a independent, community-based not-for-profit provider, founded locally in 1980 as one of the nation’s first hospices. With decades of experience serving patients and those who care about them, Samaritan now offers more life-enhancing care options and specialized services than ever before.

Samaritan is distinguished by excellent quality ratings, community partnerships and donor supported programs, such as We Honor Veterans and massage, music, and pet therapies.

Samaritan is accredited by The Joint Commission and accepts Medicare, Medicaid and most insurance plans.
